_meta.purpose: Real passenger-rail figures for SLATE journey modelling. Every figure carries its source and the date or period it applies to. Nothing here is an estimate presented as published.

conventions.minutes: Scheduled end-to-end running time in minutes, computed directly from the operator's own published timetable or GTFS feed (departure at origin to arrival at destination). 'fastest' is the minimum over the day's trains, 'median' the middle value. Where a figure comes from an operator's marketing copy instead, 'basis' says so.
conventions.frequencyPerDay: Count of trains serving BOTH stations of the pair, per direction, on the stated day, counted from the timetable/GTFS. Not an operator claim unless 'basis' says so.
conventions.amounts: Numbers in the fare's own currency (USD, GBP, EUR, MXN). No conversion.
conventions.sourceQuality: primary = operator, regulator or government; secondary = clearly labelled press/guide, used only where no primary figure was reachable and flagged in 'uncertain'.

_meta.method: Amtrak minutes/frequencies were parsed from Amtrak's official route timetable PDFs (content.amtrak.com, generated Sunday 27 Sep 2026) with pdftotext -table and a script; Metro-North from the MTA's official GTFS feed downloaded 2026-09-29 (service dates 2026-09-30 / 2026-10-03); Irish routes from the NTA's official Irish Rail GTFS (feed valid 2026-09-28 to 2027-09-28; service dates 2026-10-07/10/11); Avanti from Avanti's own 17 May - 12 Dec 2026 timetable book PDF. Pages behind JavaScript (brfares, LNER fare search, Amtrak fare search) could not be read and their numbers are null rather than guessed.

amtrakFareFamilies.note: Amtrak no longer sells 'Saver' or 'Premium' fare families. Current families for Coach, Acela Business and Acela First: Flex, Value, Sale. Non-Acela Business Class is fully refundable.
amtrakFareFamilies.Flex: Fully refundable to original form of payment with no fees if cancelled before departure; changes free (fare difference may apply).
amtrakFareFamilies.Value: Not changeable; 30% of ticket value forfeited on cancellation before departure (70% returned).
amtrakFareFamilies.Sale: Not changeable; 50% forfeited on cancellation before departure.
amtrakFareFamilies.riskFreeWindow: Full refund if cancelled within 24 hours of purchase and before departure (1 hour for unreserved services).
amtrakFareFamilies.noShow: All fares non-refundable and non-changeable after departure; a no-show forfeits the whole value of that segment.
amtrakFareFamilies.history: The Oct 2023 structure gave Value a 75% refund (25% fee); the current page says 30% forfeited.

eurostarClasses.classes: Eurostar Standard, Eurostar Plus, Eurostar Premier

StandardAndPlus.exchange: Date/time changes free up to 1 hour before original departure (fare difference payable; no refund of a cheaper fare); no destination change; may upgrade to Plus, not to Premier.
StandardAndPlus.refund: Refundable 7 or more days before departure for GBP/EUR 25 per person per leg (GBP/EUR 50 for a full return); non-refundable within 7 days.

Premier.exchange: Free date/time changes up to 48 hours AFTER original departure.
Premier.refund: Refundable with no fee up to 48 hours after original departure.

ukNationalRail.AnytimeOffPeak: From 1 April 2026 (National Rail Conditions of Travel v7), Anytime, Off-Peak, Day Travelcards and most Rangers/Rovers are refundable only up to 23:59 on the day before they become valid; admin fee up to GBP 5 per ticket (GBP 10 per season). Tickets bought on/before 31 Mar 2026 keep the old rule (refundable up to 28 days after expiry).
ukNationalRail.Advance: Not refundable (unaffected by the April 2026 change); changeable before travel for a GBP 10 admin fee plus fare difference (per Avanti and LNER). LNER allows a refund within 2 hours of purchase.

amtrak.definition: Customer on-time performance = share of customers arriving at their detraining station on time. Acela is late if more than 10 minutes after schedule; Northeast Regional and state-supported trains more than 15 minutes.
amtrak.period: August 2026 (current month) and the 12 months to August 2026

metroNorth.basis: Metro-North full-year 2025 OTP (all lines). Secondary (Metro Magazine, 5 Jan 2026, reporting the MTA year-end figures). No New Haven Line annual figure found. Metro-North's on-time threshold is not confirmed here.

ireland.definition: NTA definition: intercity trains on time if within 10 minutes; DART/commuter within 5. Includes delays outside Iarnrod Eireann's control; figures independently verified by the NTA. Four-week periods.
ireland.yearBasis: The live page lists 2026 periods 01-09 filled and 10 (7 Sep-4 Oct) blank, with 2025 and earlier as separate archive pages; the year is not printed on the table itself.

uk.definitions: ORR Table 3133, share of recorded station stops reached: within 59 seconds ('On Time'), within 3 minutes ('Time to 3', ORR's headline measure since 2025-26), within 15 minutes. Moving annual average = latest four quarters.
uk.effective: Table covers April 2014 to June 2026; Apr-Jun 2026 marked provisional [p]

uncertain: Amtrak fares: Amtrak prices dynamically and publishes no fixed or 'from' fare for any NEC pair. The only city-pair amounts found (NY-Washington from $42, Boston-NY from $21, fall sale, travel 14 Oct-17 Dec 2026) come from Time Out (28 Sep 2026); Amtrak's own sale release confirms the sale and dates but not the city-pair figures.

Amtrak 'Saver' and 'Premium' fare families asked for do not exist in the current structure (Flex / Value / Sale). Amtrak's page now says Value forfeits 30% on cancellation; the Oct 2023 launch said 25% (75% refund). A search-engine summary citing older Amtrak pages gave a different Saver/Value/Premium schedule; it was not used.
Acela First vs Business price difference: not published.
Amtrak checked-bag deadline: the 45-minute figure appears only on older/mirror Amtrak pages. The current page says check-in times vary by station, so it is null.

Amtrak timetable parsing: counts are for trains calling at both stations. Per-direction asymmetry (e.g. Acela weekday 19 NYP->WAS vs 24 WAS->NYP) comes from the timetable as parsed and was not independently checked. Northeast Regional NYP-WAS max values (~464-477 min) are probably parsing artefacts; fastest and median are the figures to use.
Amtrak on-time: figures are monthly (August 2026) and 12-month customer OTP from the Host Railroad Report, marked preliminary. No FY2026 full-year figure exists yet (FY ends 30 Sep).

Metro-North: fares taken from the Connecticut-stations page of the MTA fare table, footer dated 1 July 2026. A secondary source had a Jan 2026 peak fare of $23.25; the gap to $27.25 is more than a 5% July increase, which was not reconciled. Use the MTA document.

Metro-North on-time: only a system-wide 2025 figure (97.8%) from secondary press; no New Haven Line annual figure, and the on-time threshold (commonly 5 min 59 s) is not confirmed from a primary source.
Eurostar London-Paris and London-Brussels daily frequency: no primary figure found (Seat61, secondary: London-Paris 'every hour or two'). Left null.

Eurostar London-Amsterdam journey time: Eurostar gives 'just under 4 hours' and '4 hours 19 mins' on the same page; the example timings in its July 2025 release work out to 244 min eastbound and 257 min westbound.
Eurostar punctuality: a search-engine summary said 78.1% within 15 min for Apr 2025-Mar 2026, but the Eurostar customer-charter page itself says 83.3%. The primary page's figure is used.

Enterprise: Irish Rail walk-up fares apply only to journeys from the Republic; Belfast-origin fares are Translink's. Online Irish Rail web fares (from Dublin) are not listed statically. The Enterprise no longer serves Belfast Lanyon Place; the route is to Belfast Grand Central. The Lanyon Place detail comes from secondary sources.
Irish punctuality year: the table does not print the year; it is inferred as 2026 from the page structure (2025 and earlier are archive pages; period 10, ending 4 Oct, is still blank).
Irish Rail advance web fares for Dublin-Cork: not listed statically. The 'from EUR 21.49' figure in a search summary was not confirmed.

LNER London-Edinburgh Anytime and Off-Peak single prices: not confirmed from a primary source (the fare search is JavaScript-only and BR Fares is JavaScript-only). A search summary claimed Anytime GBP 204.80, which was not verified and is not used. LNER's route page lists Advance, Anytime and 70min Flex; whether an Off-Peak fare exists on this flow under LNER's simplified-fares pilot was not confirmed.
LNER journey time is LNER's marketing figure (4h 8m), not computed from a timetable; the same page also says 'just over four and a half hours'.
Avanti Off-Peak single: the ticket-types page says GBP 79.80, the route page says 'from GBP 76.30' (probably older copy). The ticket-types page is used.

Avanti southbound weekday frequency is a lower bound (44) because two timetable blocks did not align during parsing. Weekly engineering-works revised timetables may reduce service to 2 per hour on some dates.
UK admin fee: Avanti says refunds carry a GBP 5 admin fee; LNER says an admin charge 'will not exceed GBP 5'. The Rail Delivery Group factsheet does not state a fee.
Pacific Surfliner LA-San Diego fare: no published amount found; the booking tool is JavaScript-only.

Mexico: all El Insurgente figures are secondary (Heraldo de Mexico 17 Sep 2026; Infobae 3 Feb 2026). They conflict on the full-line fare (90 vs 100 MXN) and give journey time only as 'under an hour' / about 60 minutes. No SICT primary fare table was reached. No Mexico City intercity (long-distance) passenger rail service was confirmed in operation.
